methodology: This lookup table is not part of any standardised data dictionary; it was custom-made to serve the productivity datasets made available via data.gov.my and OpenDOSM only. Furthermore, it should be noted that the coding employed here is the same as the [coding used in](https://open.dosm.gov.my/data-catalogue/gdp_lookup) DOSM's GDP publications, except for the manufacturing and services subsectors. This is because the groupings have been calibrated to ensure optimal suitability for the productivity datasets.
